quotes.text: At APU, our transfer credit limits are: 45 academic credits toward an associate degree (up to 30 non-traditional credits)

transferMaxCredits.basis: 60 degree credits minus the 45-credit transfer ceiling.

quotes.text: At APU, our transfer credit limits are: 45 academic credits toward an associate degree (up to 30 non-traditional credits)
“Non-traditional” transfer credits are those earned based on assessment, competency testing (i.e. CLEP or ACE exams)

alternativeMaxCredits.basis: Sophia credit is ACE-recommended, which the school counts as non-traditional transfer credit.

externalMaxCredits.scope: 60 degree credits minus the 45-credit transfer ceiling.

institutionMinCredits.scope: Minimum credits completed at the school.
institutionMinCredits.calculation: 60 degree credits minus the 45-credit transfer ceiling.

modelFields.coverageLabel: Complete named 60-credit APU starting plan with school-published course equivalencies; up to 30 nontraditional credits and 45 total transfer credits. Individual admission and transfer awards remain personal decisions.

policyReview.message: The complete APU associate ledger has no separate degree-wide upper-level minimum; each named requirement retains its actual level.

rulesNotes: The institution is American Public University, using its APU catalog and transfer finder; this review does not extend a decision to every school in the parent System.
The 45-credit total transfer limit is separate from the 30-credit nontraditional limit. Starting from zero with the reviewed alternatives selects 30 outside credits and 30 APU credits.
Named general-education and free-elective selections are complete starting choices from the published lists. They do not replace the broader catalog lists or create personal credit awards.
One original outside course is counted at most once; shared requirement credit is not duplicated.

pricing.notes: Standard undergraduate tuition before grants and aid; $250 associate graduation fee. Current published Opportunity, military and other grants are separate eligibility-based scenarios.

pacePolicy.basis: Each named APU course has a retained official Course Schedule with start/end dates and a stated session length. Those section dates do not establish whether coursework is self-paced within the session. No current registration availability, fixed completion date, live attendance or competency-based status is asserted.
